# Holdline

> Borrow against your tokenized stocks on Kamino and never get liquidated in your sleep.

**Live Demo:** repo clone-run (boot the mainnet fork + keeper) | **Demo Video:** `submission/demo-video.mp4` (YouTube link added when uploaded) | **GitHub:** https://github.com/dmustapha/holdline

---

## The Problem
Tokenized stocks (xStocks) trade 24/7 on Solana, but the underlying equities do not. When Wall Street is closed, an xStock can gap on thin weekend liquidity while you are asleep, push your Kamino loan past its liquidation threshold, and get you liquidated before you ever see it. Every borrower holding a USDC loan against xStock collateral over a weekend sits in that window with nothing watching it. A brokerage app would margin-call you in the morning. On-chain, the liquidation is already done.

## What We Built
Holdline is the guard for that exact window. You borrow USDC against xStock collateral on Kamino as normal, then arm **Protect**: pre-fund a small USDC reserve into an on-chain vault and set a trigger LTV. A continuously running keeper polls your loan health and the equity-market clock. When your LTV crosses the trigger while the market is closed, the keeper fires a single protective repay that brings the loan back under the trigger. You never click anything.

In the demo a judge watches the health bar go red, then green, with nobody at the keyboard: the keeper detects the breach and fires the repay on its own, dropping a real Kamino obligation from `LTV 8029 -> 5954 bps`.

## Our Integration
- **Kamino KLend (xStocks lending market).** The keeper reads live obligation LTV via `@kamino-finance/klend-sdk` 7.3.22 and the protective repay is a top-level Kamino `repay_obligation_liquidity_v2` against the borrower's real obligation. Integration code: `adapters/kamino/src/{market,obligation,txns,repay-accounts}.ts`, `keeper/src/{detect,fire-toplevel}.ts`. Bound obligation `2qvrAwYC68q6zyN4BzV9b8tvupGcZjnfQVmCFKf9gkgi` on the xStocks market `5wJeMrUYECGq41fxRESKALVcHnNX26TAWy4W98yULsua` (13 reserves), a real borrower obligation with genuine USDC debt cloned from mainnet.
- **Holdline Vault (Anchor 0.32).** A repay-only custody program, `4YSxGTVgKBca27gxkgZRK4GbxGm2afnBTya7mTLiSJcw`. `release_to_keeper` introspects the Instructions sysvar and reverts unless a bound Kamino repay of exactly the released amount appears in the same transaction. Enforcement code: `programs/holdline-vault/src/instructions/release_to_keeper.rs`.
- **Keeper.** A TypeScript poll loop (`keeper/`) that evaluates LTV plus the market clock and signs the atomic fire only on a genuine breach. It is the sole signer.

Full evidence, addresses, and signatures: [`submission/proof.md`](proof.md).

## What Makes This Different
This is the only tokenized-stock borrow product whose overnight liquidation protection actually fires unattended. Others surface risk or ask you to click. Holdline acts while you sleep, and it does so without asking you to trust the operator: the release and the bound repay are indivisible in one transaction, so the keeper can never divert a cent. Custody is a program invariant proven by five reverting positive controls, not a promise.

## Track
Main track (Solana Foundation). No paid sponsor SDK is claimed; Kamino's xStocks lending market is the integration surface. See [sponsor-tracks.md](sponsor-tracks.md).

## Tech Stack
- **On-chain:** Anchor 0.32 vault program (Rust), Solana.
- **Lending:** Kamino KLend via `@kamino-finance/klend-sdk` 7.3.22 (`@solana/kit`-native).
- **Keeper:** TypeScript poll-loop service (`keeper/`), Dockerfile + Railway manifest for continuous running.
- **App:** Next.js 14 dashboard; the server only builds unsigned transactions, it never holds keys.

## Try It
```bash
git clone https://github.com/dmustapha/holdline.git
cd holdline
npm install
npm test                       # 18/18 core: LTV trigger math, market-hours, trigger-boundary, IDL structure
cd app && npm install && npm run test:teeth   # 34/34 design: token-drift, forbidden-defaults, WCAG contrast
```
The full unattended-repay flow runs against a mainnet fork you boot yourself. Steps and the six custody controls are in the repo README ["Run the full protective flow"](../README.md#run-the-full-protective-flow-mainnet-fork).

## Demo Walkthrough
1. Open `/demo`. The loan health bar shows the position sitting near the trigger.
2. Arm Protect (fund a small USDC reserve, set the trigger LTV). This is the only user signature.
3. Trigger the overnight gap (the in-app "simulate overnight gap" control arms the demo clock the keeper reads).
4. Watch the health bar go red, then the keeper fires the protective repay unattended and it goes green: `LTV 8029 -> 5954 bps`, keeper the sole signer.
5. Read the sole-signer proof card (`solana confirm -v`: exactly one signer, the keeper).

## Verify in 60s
One action re-derives the headline claim from a fresh clone, no keys and no network:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dmustapha/holdline.git && cd holdline && npm install && npm test
```

Expected: `18/18` core tests pass. These assert the exact fire gate the keeper uses (a fire lands strictly `< trigger` and never loops), so the trigger math behind the `LTV 8029 -> 5954` hero is re-derived, not just displayed.

For the strongest tier (a real protective repay on a live mainnet fork), boot the fork and run `node_modules/.bin/ts-node scripts/control-hardening.ts`, which prints `ALL HARDENING CONTROLS PASSED` (6/6 divert attempts revert) alongside the passing hero fire. The rot-proof committed record of the hero (addresses, signatures, before/after LTV) is [`submission/proof.md`](proof.md).

## Demo Notes
- **Real:** the Kamino KLend program, the xStocks lending market and its 13 reserves plus oracles, and a real borrower obligation with genuine USDC debt (all cloned from mainnet); the Anchor vault program; the unattended keeper fire; the sole-signer atomic tx; the 6/6 reverting custody controls; `18/18` core + `34/34` design tests.
- **Seeded:** the demo wallet's and keeper's USDC token accounts are disclosed test balances of the real USDC mint, pre-funded on the local validator; the demo position is an honest, labelled opt-in ("Load demo position").
- **Network:** a `$0` local `solana-test-validator` running as a mainnet fork. No mainnet writes. The same program deploys to mainnet unchanged.
